pairs.registryProposal: isolation-lanes frames the inheritance ledger per lane and per process; the commonest leak in an in-process unit suite is a module-singleton store (zustand/redux) that survives between tests in one file while the runner isolates only per file. A sentence naming module-scope state as 'from the previous test' inheritance, with a reset hatch as the conformant shape, would make this case judgeable without inference.
